headline: Delta flights in and out of Atlanta delayed due to system outage
summary: Delta flights at Atlanta's major hub face significant delays. A system outage impacting plane weight/balance calculations is the cause. The disruption affects Delta only but could have broader impacts.

headline: Binding of Isaac developer removes AI music from Repentance Plus
summary: Binding of Isaac: Repentance Plus received backlash for using AI-generated music. Players discovered Suno metadata in audio files from a GTA-themed section. The developer has since removed the controversial AI music.

headline: Some of our favorite Switch 2 games are cheaper through Black Friday
summary: Black Friday offers significant discounts on Nintendo Switch 2 games. Nintendo is offering $50 off console bundles. Many popular games are also reduced by $20.

headline: Sheherazaad’s Khudgarzi is gorgeous, ‘genre-chaotic’ South Asian folk
summary: Sheherazaad releases "Khudgarzi," a reverb-drenched folk-noir debut LP. The album is primarily sung in Urdu. It draws on traditional South Asian music styles like Carnatic and Hindustani.

headline: Rockstar Says Darts Were Cut From GTA 6 Because It Didn't Have 'Unlimited Money or Time' to Make It 'Feel Proper'
summary: Rockstar Games omitted darts and bowling from GTA 6. The studio cited limited money and time as reasons. They couldn't make these mini-games "feel proper."

headline: Amazon and Target Launch '3 for 2' Sales on Books, Box Sets, and Vinyl for Black Friday
summary: Amazon and Target are offering '3 for 2' sales for Black Friday. The deals cover books, box sets, and vinyl records. This provides a great opportunity to expand entertainment collections.

headline: The Best Deals Today: Donkey Kong Bananza, Ghost of Yotei, Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, and More
summary: Discover today's top gaming deals. Featured games include Donkey Kong Bananza, Ghost of Yotei, and Castlevania: Belmont's Curse. Find discounts on various popular titles.

headline: Rockstar Says Jason's Viral Personality in GTA 6 Comes From Steve McQueen and Real-Life Veterans
summary: Rockstar Games revealed inspirations for GTA 6 protagonist Jason. His viral personality is influenced by Steve McQueen. Real-life veterans also contributed to his character.

headline: COP31 fails to reach major climate deal as talks expose deep divisions
summary: COP31 climate talks concluded without a major deal. Deep divisions emerged, particularly over fossil fuels. Negotiations failed to make a breakthrough on global climate action.

headline: What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?
summary: COP31 talks ended without an agreement. Negotiations extended two days past their scheduled close. The lack of a deal raises questions about future climate action.

headline: Boss of British Gas owner Centrica 'hugely concerned' over impact of soaring energy bills
summary: Centrica CEO Chris O'Shea expresses deep concern over rising energy bills. He predicts an increase in customers unable to pay in the new year. This comes as prices are set to jump.

headline: Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
summary: A Russian ship at a Libyan port experienced an explosion. Officials suspect a drone attack was the cause. The ship was reportedly stopping for fuel and supplies en route to Russia.
